premise: Snail wants to thank Bird for his song, but Bird's branch is far too high to climb; tiny Ladybug offers to take the thank-you, lifts her red spotted shell and finds her thin wings folded underneath — and flies.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: what she needed was hers all along, and she finds it by trying to help a friend.
lesson: Wanting to help can show you what you can do.
learning: A ladybug's thin flying wings are folded under its spotted shell.

en-US.title: Ladybug Flies Up High
en-US.text: Every morning, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Bird sang from his branch, high up in the big tree. {bird:live} {sfx:song} Tweedle-dee! Down in the grass, {snail:enter} Snail loved that song. {snail:face happy} I'd like to say thank you, he said. But the branch was so high. {snail:face sad} [slowly] It would take me all week to get there. {ladybug:enter} Ladybug was listening. {ladybug:hop} I'll take your thank-you! But… how? She couldn't climb that high either. She thought. And thought. [curious] Then she gave a wiggle. {ladybug:live hold} She lifted her red shell with its six black spots — and underneath were two thin, see-through wings! {ladybug:sparkle} [gasps] Wings! My own wings! {snail:face surprised} Snail's eyes went wide. {ladybug:live resume} {sfx:flutter} Ladybug fluttered them… once… twice… {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:go to bird by fly} and UP she flew, all the way to Bird. [excited] Thank you for your song, from Snail! {bird:face happy} {bird:hearts} Bird looked down at Snail. Then he {bird:live} sang his very best song, just for him. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] And Snail heard every note.

es-ES.title: Mariquita vuela muy alto
es-ES.text: Cada mañana, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Pájaro cantaba desde su rama, allá arriba en el árbol grande. {bird:live} {sfx:song} ¡Tirurí! Abajo, en la hierba, a {snail:enter} Caracol le encantaba esa canción. {snail:face happy} Quiero darle las gracias, dijo. Pero la rama estaba altísima. {snail:face sad} [slowly] Tardaría una semana entera en llegar. {ladybug:enter} Mariquita lo estaba escuchando. {ladybug:hop} ¡Yo le llevo tus gracias! Pero… ¿cómo? Ella tampoco podía trepar tan alto. Pensó. Y pensó. [curious] Entonces se meneó un poquito. {ladybug:live hold} Levantó su caparazón rojo de seis lunares negros… ¡y debajo había dos alas finitas y transparentes! {ladybug:sparkle} [gasps] ¡Alas! ¡Mis propias alas! {snail:face surprised} Caracol abrió mucho los ojos. {ladybug:live resume} {sfx:flutter} Mariquita las batió… una vez… dos veces… {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:go to bird by fly} ¡y voló muy ARRIBA, hasta Pájaro! [excited] ¡Gracias por tu canción, de parte de Caracol! {bird:face happy} {bird:hearts} Pájaro miró a Caracol, allá abajo. Y {bird:live} cantó su mejor canción, solo para él. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Y Caracol oyó cada nota.
